services.desc: There’s no better way to experience the iconic Navy Pier fireworks than from a private sailboat or yacht on Lake Michigan. Our Navy Pier fireworks sailboat and yacht rentals in Chicago offer a front-row view of the show, paired with breathtaking skyline scenery and a relaxed, unforgettable atmosphere on the water. Your evening begins with a scenic cruise along the Chicago shoreline as the sun sets behind the city and the skyline lights up. As showtime approaches, your professional captain will position the boat for optimal viewing-either close to Navy Pier for an up-close experience or farther out beyond the breakwater for a wider panoramic view.
